message.content:
Sure! If you want to list the contents of the C drive from the command prompt, you can use:

```cmd
dir C:\
```

or, if you're using PowerShell:

```powershell
Get-ChildItem C:\
```

Just open a Command Prompt (or PowerShell) window and paste one of those commands to see the files and folders on your C drive.
